definition.title: Take a weekly traffic snapshot and growth readout
definition.description: Each week, read Search Console and PostHog once into one file. Per landing page it holds clicks, impressions and top searches, sessions by channel, first-touch signups and activation, reading depth and the latest audit's checks; Page decisions, the page tree and the blog index read it instead of querying again. The same file carries the weekly growth readout: where visitors and signups came from, by channel and by named AI assistant, search with a brand split, content and landing pages, with a change called only when an exact test with Holm's correction says it is real, and each decision naming the workflow that acts on it. No model calls; a failed read stays empty, never zero.

prerequisites.reason: The audit's summary (reports/organic-audit/LATEST.json, from policy v12) names the site's host and the checks that flag each page.

signup_event.title: Signup event
signup_event.description: The PostHog event a new account sends, such as signed_up. Leave empty to skip signups.

activation_event.title: Activation event
activation_event.description: The PostHog event that means a new account got value. Leave empty to skip activation.

activation_window_days.title: Days after signup that count as activation

paid_event.title: Paid event
paid_event.description: The PostHog event for a first payment, counted within 28 days of signup. Leave empty to skip.

website_hosts.title: Website hosts
website_hosts.description: Leave empty to use the audited host, or the top host in Search Console.

brand_terms.title: Brand terms (regular expressions)
brand_terms.description: Searches that name the product. Leave empty to derive them from the host.

internal_flag_property.title: Internal-user flag property
internal_flag_property.description: A PostHog property that is true for team members; person properties start with person:.

always_include.title: Paths to always list in detail, such as /pricing

impressions_reliable_from.title: Impressions reliable from (YYYY-MM-DD)
impressions_reliable_from.description: Only when the Search Console property changed: earlier impressions are left out of weekly and monthly rows.

audit_run_id.title: Organic audit run
audit_run_id.description: Leave empty to use the newest audit's summary (LATEST.json). A named run needs a SUMMARY.json, which audits write from policy v12.

content_paths.title: Content path prefixes
content_paths.description: For the readout's content table. Defaults to /blog/, /docs/, /guides/ and /changelog/.

min_count.title: Smallest count a change is tested on

launch_dates.title: Launch or announcement dates (YYYY-MM-DD)
launch_dates.description: Weeks holding one are marked, so a spike is not read as a trend.
